@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+Feature: Lexer error handling
+  Validate how the lexer deals with illegal input characters and error handlers.
+
+  Scenario: error handler re-emits the illegal token
+    Given a lexer that keeps illegal characters via the error handler
+    When I lex "a(b)a"
+    Then the tokens should match snapshot "error_handler_tokens"
+
+  Scenario: missing error handler raises an exception
+    Given a lexer without an error handler
+    When I lex "a(b)a"
+    Then an illegal character error is raised
+
+  Scenario: error handler can swallow characters
+    Given a lexer whose error handler drops the illegal token
+    When I lex "a1"
+    Then the tokens should match snapshot "error_handler_nil_tokens"

@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require 'yaml'
+
+# Step helper module for lexer fixtures
+module LexerSteps
+  FIXTURE_DIR = File.expand_path('../fixtures', __dir__)
+
+  def build_lexer(constant_name, &block)
+    Object.send(:remove_const, constant_name) if Object.const_defined?(constant_name)
+    klass = Class.new(WLex::Lexer)
+    klass.instance_eval(&block)
+    Object.const_set(constant_name, klass)
+    @lexer = klass.new
+  end
+
+  def load_snapshot(snapshot_name)
+    path = File.join(FIXTURE_DIR, "#{snapshot_name}.yaml")
+    YAML.load_file(path).map do |token|
+      [token[0].to_sym, token[1], token[2], token[3]]
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+World(LexerSteps)
+
+Given('a lexer that keeps illegal characters via the error handler') do
+  build_lexer(:SnapshotErrorLexer) do
+    tokens(:IDENTIFIER)
+    rule(:IDENTIFIER, /a|b/)
+    error do |_lexer, token|
+      token
+    end
+    ignore " \t"
+  end
+end
+
+Given('a lexer without an error handler') do
+  build_lexer(:NoErrorLexer) do
+    tokens(:IDENTIFIER)
+    rule(:IDENTIFIER, /a|b/)
+    ignore " \t"
+  end
+end
+
+Given('a lexer whose error handler drops the illegal token') do
+  build_lexer(:NilErrorLexer) do
+    tokens(:NUMBER)
+    rule(:NUMBER, /[0-9]+/)
+    error do |_lexer, _token|
+      nil
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+When('I lex {string}') do |input|
+  @last_input = input
+  @lex_error = nil
+  @lex_result = nil
+  begin
+    @lex_result = @lexer.lex(input).map(&:to_ary)
+  rescue StandardError => e
+    @lex_error = e
+  end
+end
+
+Then('the tokens should match snapshot {string}') do |snapshot|
+  expect(@lex_result).to eq(load_snapshot(snapshot))
+end
+
+Then('an illegal character error is raised') do
+  expect(@lex_error).to be_a(WLex::LexerError)
+  expect(@lex_error.message).to match(/Illegal character/)
+end
